ownerNotes.title: City and highway fuel economy varies widely
ownerNotes.summary: Owners have reported city results from roughly 6.5–14 km/l and highway or long-run results from roughly 13–19 km/l. Traffic, speed, terrain, fuel, transmission and measurement method differ, so these are examples—not an expected range or guarantee.
ownerNotes.caution: Do not compare results without matching driving conditions and measurement method. The figures are unverified owner submissions.

ownerNotes.title: MID readings and tank-to-tank results are not interchangeable
ownerNotes.summary: Members discussed differences between the dashboard MID estimate and manually calculated tank-to-tank fuel economy. Some journey reports include both values.
ownerNotes.caution: The chat includes broad claims about accuracy. Use a consistent fill-up method and consult the owner manual; this site does not certify either reading.

ownerNotes.title: Door sounds and cabin rattles have more than one reported cause
ownerNotes.summary: Owners described door rattling or squeaking, different checks, and different attempted remedies. Some cases were unresolved or required a return visit to an authorized service centre.
ownerNotes.caution: These anecdotes do not establish a common defect or an approved repair. Ask an authorized service centre to inspect persistent or safety-related symptoms.

ownerNotes.title: Pedal vibration, brake noise and gear feel are owner-reported concerns
ownerNotes.summary: The chats include reports of pedal vibration under acceleration, brake noise or vibration, and stiff manual gear shifts. Reports differ by vehicle and some owners were arranging an ASC inspection.
ownerNotes.caution: A chat message is not a diagnosis. Have braking or control concerns inspected promptly by Renault/ASC; do not rely on this page to troubleshoot them.

ownerNotes.title: One owner raised an unexpected ADAS braking concern
ownerNotes.summary: A member described unexpected active braking and raised the experience with the group. There is no independent verification, technical diagnosis or confirmed fix.
ownerNotes.caution: This is not evidence of a widespread fault and is not a troubleshooting guide. Report unexpected braking to Renault/ASC promptly and follow the owner manual.

ownerNotes.title: Air-conditioning and wireless charging feedback is mixed
ownerNotes.summary: Members compared A/C behaviour across trims and described phone-dependent wireless charging performance. The discussion includes an unverified service-update explanation for an A/C concern.
ownerNotes.caution: No software campaign or trim-specific feature conclusion is confirmed here. Ask an authorized service centre to check the vehicle and applicable updates.

ownerNotes.title: Accessory fit and finish matter more than the label
ownerNotes.summary: Owners discussed dash cameras, full-coverage floor mats, magnetic shades, coatings and paint protection. Feedback includes personal preferences and prices that may have changed.
ownerNotes.caution: Check fitment for your exact variant and confirm legal, warranty and safety implications before buying or installing anything.

ownerNotes.title: Specific accessory choices are individual reports, not endorsements
ownerNotes.summary: Owners mentioned a dual-channel dash camera, TPE floor mats intended to cover the door-sill area, and magnetic window shades. One owner-reported price for mats was about ₹4,800 in September 2026; it is historical, not a current quote.
ownerNotes.caution: Confirm exact vehicle fit, current price, installation and warranty impact with the seller and manufacturer. No product is endorsed by the community.

ownerNotes.title: Window film and coating discussions need current checks
ownerNotes.summary: Members discussed heat-rejecting films, magnetic shades, paint coatings and PPF, including conflicting assumptions about local enforcement and product value.
ownerNotes.caution: The chat is not legal or product guidance. Check current local rules and written warranty terms before installation or purchase.

ownerNotes.title: Fuel-grade and additive claims were not independently verified
ownerNotes.summary: Members compared regular and premium petrol and speculated about additives, engine cleanliness and mileage. These conversations do not establish that a particular fuel improves economy or cleans components.
ownerNotes.caution: Use fuel that meets the vehicle manual’s requirements. Do not rely on group speculation for engine or fuel-system advice.

ownerNotes.title: Fuel-capacity and reserve advice needs a manual reference
ownerNotes.summary: A specific tank/reserve figure and refuelling advice were circulated in the fuel chat, but no manual citation or independent verification accompanied them.
ownerNotes.caution: Check the owner manual or Renault/ASC for capacity and refuelling guidance; the chat does not establish pump-damage risk or repair cost.

ownerNotes.title: Spare-wheel delivery and dealer follow-up came up in ownership discussions
ownerNotes.summary: Owners discussed waiting for a spare wheel/stepney and varied dealership experiences, including delays and follow-ups.
ownerNotes.caution: This is not a statement of current supply status or a promise of delivery time. Confirm your order status with your dealer.

ownerNotes.title: The group is already organized around owner needs
ownerNotes.summary: Admin conversations describe an unofficial owner-led community with focused conversations for ownership, mileage, repairs, accessories and trips, plus onboarding and moderation.

ownerNotes.title: Meetups and drives are member-organized
ownerNotes.summary: Members shared meetup and route ideas. Check the community for current plans.
ownerNotes.caution: Confirm dates, route conditions and permissions before sharing plans.
